Subject: Re: SIG - follow-up items: key management and rotation — artifacts attached

Lisa — attaching the requested SIG section and evidence bundle for ProcureCorp's review. Summary of the key points up-front:

- Key ownership and origin: Redwood offers provider-managed keys by default (Redwood-managed CMKs). We also support BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for enterprise Dedicated/Private customers — see note below.
- HSM usage: Provider-managed CMKs are generated and stored in a cloud KMS backed by HSMs (Luna/SafeNet) with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 attestations. Refer to attached hsm_attestation_202512.pdf.
- Key wrapping: Master CMKs are generated within the HSM-backed KMS and are not exportable in plaintext. All envelope encryption uses these CMKs to wrap data keys; wrapped keys are stored alongside encrypted data.
- Rotation cadence and enforcement: Our policy (attached kms_rotation_policy.md) mandates rotation of master CMKs every 90 days and rotation of subordinate data keys more frequently as workload dictates. Rotation orchestration is automated via our KMS-controller pipeline; rotation events are recorded to immutable audit logs (Cloud Logging and an append-only audit S3 bucket).
- Evidence: attached rotation_log_excerpt_20261102.csv (redacted), and a topology diagram kms_arch_diagram_20261102.png showing where HSM-backed KMS sits relative to serving runtime and secrets manager.

Attachments included: sig_kms_answers_20261102.pdf (completed SIG section answers), hsm_attestation_202512.pdf, kms_rotation_policy.md, kms_arch_diagram_20261102.png, rotation_log_excerpt_20261102.csv

BYOK note: We support BYOK for our Private and Dedicated offerings — customers can upload keys via a customer-managed HSM or via our BYOK API. When BYOK is used, the customer is responsible for key lifecycle; Redwood treats BYOK keys as non-exportable and enforces the same access-control and audit logging. If you want, I can include a short appendix with the BYOK onboarding steps and our recommended KMS/HSM vendors.

Link to drive with full artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Ckms-evidence

Please let me know if you need additional excerpts or an attestation of the rotation events from our audit pipeline.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
